architectureDecisions: D1 — Optional requiredFiles: unique relative POSIX paths that pass assertSafeWorkspacePath (../../agentic-system/src/index.js). Omitted or [] omits the key on the frozen task (id, repositoryRoot, baseRevision, prompt, verifications). Bad path: TypeError `AGENT_TASK_V1 invalid:`. Extra fields ignored.

D2 — resolveAgentTaskContext(task, { repositoryReader=null, maxMaterializedBytes=1048576, snapshotObserve=null }). Non-empty requiredFiles → EXACT ContextRequirement: consumerRef `agent-task:<id>`, evidence id file-<i> REQUIRED REPOSITORY itemRefs [path] snapshot {mode:EXACT, ref:task.baseRevision}, budget {maxItems n, maxProviderCalls n, maxResolutionSteps 1, maxMaterializedBytes}. Catalog: createExactRepositoryProvider({repositoryReader}) + snapshotAuthorities [{sourceKind:REPOSITORY, refPrefix:task.repositoryRoot, observe: snapshotObserve ?? (() => ({snapshotRef: task.baseRevision}))}], createRetrievalPlanner, createOracleContextResolver. Default reader git show <revision>:<path> → {content, sourceRef:`${revision}:${path}`}. Non-positive maxMaterializedBytes: TypeError. Omitted/[] → {used:false, items:[], promptPrefix:''} with zero factory calls.

D3 — used:true requires COMPLETE + assertConsumableContextResolution. Else throw AgentTaskContextError {name:'AgentTaskContextError', code:'CONTEXT_UNSATISFIED', status, unresolved, failures, reason}. Map non-COMPLETE → resolution.status; DurabilityFailure → status STALE reason STALE_DURING_RESOLUTION; TypeError consumed below materialization/step (maxMaterializedBytes:1) → UNSATISFIED. runSupervisedTask throws after validateAgentTask and before createLocalGitWorkspace. AgentTaskStatus is not widened.

D5 — runSupervisedTask adds repositoryReader, maxMaterializedBytes, snapshotObserve and passes them only to resolveAgentTaskContext. invocationObserver remains default-null and is still awaited in ACT.

D6 — Tests CX1..CX6 in task-context.test.js use fake-agent.mjs and temp git repos. Happy path: requiredFiles ['src/app.js'], maxMaterializedBytes 8192, prefix + `.exharness/context/src/app.js` at spawn (invocationObserver), porcelain empty, HEAD=baseRevision. Spawn = FAKE_AGENT_RECORD present.

D7 — Probe: EXACT git COMPLETE; missing SOURCE_FAILURE; budget 2 BUDGET_EXHAUSTED; budget 1 TypeError consumed below materialization/step; drifting observe DurabilityFailure STALE_DURING_RESOLUTION; AgentTaskStatus has no CONTEXT_UNSATISFIED; exclude clears porcelain.
D8 — Living context.md + state.md; README pointer to context.md; no Blackboard ids; not described as Backend/QA adoption.

D9 — task-context-scope-audit.mjs reuses auditPaths from scope-audit.mjs. CX6 matcher-only: write-scope paths pass; packages/oracle, core-harness, agentic-system, docs/blackboard, agent-tools.test.js, run-trace.test.js fail.
